Canada.processing: Douglas-Peucker generalization; capital rings retained at finer precision; small offshore features omitted.

US.processing: TIGERweb state/equivalent polygons, selected DC/PR/GU/VI/AS/MP; finely generalized.

UM.dataset: GSHHG 2.3.7 full-resolution L1 shorelines, NOAA NCEI archive
UM.attribution: Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith, SOEST/NOAA
UM.processing: Nine named island/atoll groups extracted; individual shorelines retained. Display arranged as separate insets, not a connected geographic outline.

adjacency: Curated shared land/inland-water boundaries on Census/Statistics Canada maps. Original U.S. state water-border graph retained; new offshore maritime boundaries and corner-only contacts excluded. Neighbors in quizzes restricted to enabled locations.
comparison_policy: Population comparisons require the same census/estimate reference date. Expanded area comparisons use land only; default state-only mode retains total area. UM excluded from both Showdowns because no comparable numeric census/area fact is bundled.
fact_notes: PE freshwater area is not reported in the Atlas table and is stored as null, not zero.
Ontario and Nunavut motto spellings follow the Governor General heraldic register and the Nunavut Legislative Assembly, respectively.
